title: Asymmetric Multimodal Learning with Decomposed JEPAs
code_status: 固定v1明确链接作者参考实现；已读取固定commit的models.py/training.py，不执行其下载或全套训练。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.foundation_models.d_jepa import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42, device="cpu"))'

cost_assessment.source: Fixed v1 Section 4 and Appendix C, fixed author README/training.py
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: CLEVR 3,000 scenes, frozen DINOv2/BERT, six representation arms, 3,000 updates per trained arm and three seeds, plus 60-epoch probes and 400-step flow-PID audits; synthetic suite is separate.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: The full multi-arm, multi-seed feature-extraction/probe/PID suite requires additional downloads and a long campaign, rather than a cheap objective check; no GPU-hour estimate is invented. Source has an internal 3,000x6 versus 12,000-pair count inconsistency, retained in docs.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；只实现论文单context共享/私有目标和梯度路由，不下载CLEVR或backbone、不伪称信息论/下游能力验证。

summary: 将每模态表示拆成共享core与私有fiber，分开SIGReg防塌缩；用另一view的stop-gradient目标恢复信息，并仅惩罚四组shared-private相关，不约束两个private直接对齐。本地复现论文Eq3–8单context机制，说明作者多view平均系数差异；完整实验高成本不复现。
